items.q: The foundation controller drug class for persistent asthma at every step is what?
items.exp: Inhaled corticosteroids suppress airway inflammation, cutting exacerbations and asthma mortality, and anchor all persistent asthma regimens onto which other agents are added.
r: Incorrect. Montelukast is add on, never the foundation.
Correct. Inhaled steroids anchor asthma control.
Incorrect. Chronic oral steroids are last resort toxicity.
Incorrect. Theophylline is a narrow specialist add on.
items.kp: Persistent asthma always stands on inhaled steroids.

items.q: Why must long acting beta agonists never be used alone in asthma?
o: Bronchodilation without anti inflammatory cover increases severe attacks and death
items.exp: LABA monotherapy masks symptoms while inflammation advances, a pattern linked to increased asthma deaths, so regulators mandate combination with inhaled corticosteroids in asthma.
r: Incorrect. Resistance is not the safety story.
Correct. Relief without inflammation control kills.
Incorrect. Their duration is a reliable twelve hours.
Incorrect. They dilate; the danger is untreated inflammation.
items.kp: No LABA without ICS in asthma, ever.

items.q: Oral candidiasis and hoarseness from inhaled steroids are best reduced by what?
o: Spacer use and rinsing mouth after inhalation
items.exp: Local deposition causes thrush and dysphonia; spacers improve lung delivery while rinsing clears oropharyngeal residue, preventing most local effects without systemic antifungals.
r: Incorrect. Stopping controllers invites fatal attacks.
Correct. Spacer plus rinse prevents local harm.
Incorrect. Routine antifungals are unnecessary overkill.
Incorrect. Oral steroids multiply systemic harm.
items.kp: Rinse and spit after every steroid puff.

items.q: Montelukast is especially favoured as add on therapy in which asthma pattern?
o: Exercise induced and aspirin sensitive asthma
items.exp: Leukotriene antagonism suits exercise triggered symptoms and NSAID exacerbated disease where leukotrienes dominate, taken orally at night. It never rescues acute attacks.
r: Incorrect. Brittle disease needs specialist escalation and biologics.
Correct. Exercise and aspirin sensitive patterns fit.
Incorrect. Hepatic caution applies but is not an indication.
Incorrect. Relievers and steroids rescue attacks, not montelukast.
items.kp: Exercise wheeze at night dosing: montelukast.

items.q: Theophylline demands level monitoring chiefly because of what property?
o: Narrow therapeutic index with arrhythmia and seizure toxicity
items.exp: Theophylline's bronchodilator levels sit close to toxic levels causing arrhythmias and seizures, and CYP interactions with infection, smoking and many drugs swing levels unpredictably.
r: Incorrect. Its margin is famously narrow.
Correct. Narrow index plus interactions need levels.
Incorrect. Interactions are numerous and dangerous.
Incorrect. Hepatic CYP metabolism dominates its clearance.
items.kp: Narrow window drug: always check theophylline levels.

items.q: Omalizumab suits severe asthma with which dominant phenotype?
o: Allergic IgE mediated with raised IgE and sensitisation
items.exp: Omalizumab binds free IgE preventing mast cell activation, dosed by weight and IgE in severe allergic asthma. Eosinophil driven disease instead matches anti interleukin 5 biologics.
r: Incorrect. Neutrophilic disease lacks targeted biologics here.
Correct. Allergic IgE phenotype is omalizumab territory.
Incorrect. That phenotype matches mepolizumab class drugs.
Incorrect. Aspirin sensitivity is leukotriene pathway business.
items.kp: Match the biologic to the biomarker fingerprint.

items.q: In COPD, inhaled corticosteroids are restricted to selected patients mainly because they increase risk of what?
items.exp: COPD trials show inhaled steroids raise pneumonia incidence, so they are reserved for frequent exacerbators with eosinophilic signals where exacerbation benefit outweighs infection risk.
r: Incorrect. Steroids neither cure nor cause cancer here.
Correct. Pneumonia risk limits COPD steroid use.
Incorrect. Dilators keep working alongside steroids.
Incorrect. Renal stones are not the trial signal.
items.kp: COPD steroids: fewer attacks, more pneumonia, choose carefully.

items.q: Intravenous magnesium in acute severe asthma helps mainly by doing what?
o: Relaxing bronchial smooth muscle as adjunct when response is poor
items.exp: Magnesium relaxes airway smooth muscle and stabilises mast cells as an adjunct in severe attacks responding poorly to nebulisers and steroids, buying time while escalation is arranged.
r: Incorrect. IgE blockade is chronic omalizumab therapy.
Correct. It is an acute bronchodilator adjunct.
Incorrect. Steroids remain mandatory in attacks.
Incorrect. Mucolysis is not its acute role.
items.kp: Severe attack not responding: add magnesium, keep escalating.

items.q: Suppressing cough with codeine mixtures is most harmful in which condition?
o: Bronchiectasis with daily purulent sputum needing clearance
items.exp: Productive bronchiectatic cough clears infected secretions; suppression retains pus, worsening infection and exacerbations, so airway clearance physiotherapy replaces antitussives there.
r: Incorrect. Brief night use for dry cough is the lesser concern.
Correct. Never trap infected secretions inside.
Incorrect. Post viral cough fades and suppression is optional comfort.
Incorrect. Reflux needs acid and lifestyle therapy mainly.
items.kp: Wet productive cough is a clearance tool, not a symptom to crush.

items.q: High dose nebulised salbutamol during attacks most characteristically disturbs which electrolyte?
items.exp: Beta 2 stimulation drives potassium into cells causing transient hypokalaemia with tremor and tachycardia, monitored during repeated nebulisation alongside lactate rise.
r: Incorrect. Sodium is not the beta agonist signature.
Correct. Potassium shifts inward and falls.
Incorrect. Calcium is governed by PTH pathways instead.
Incorrect. Magnesium is given therapeutically, not raised by salbutamol.
items.kp: Shaky, fast, low potassium: expected salbutamol spillover.
